text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Stefanie Marinich-Lee has resigned from the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee effective February 23, 2021. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office and Equity, Diversity, and Human Rights in the People and Equity Office are working on a process to recruit applicants and help bring a nominated candidate to City Council for their consideration. If you have any questions about this update, please contact the Public Appointments Secretariat at appoint@toronto.ca or 416-397-0088.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
